preview.what: Closures, scope, this, and prototypes — how JavaScript actually resolves names.
preview.picture: A closure is a backpack: a function carries the variables from where it was born. 'this' is a name tag that changes depending on who is calling you. Prototypes are a chain of 'ask my parent if I don't know'.
preview.why: Every JS screen has one closure-in-a-loop or lost-this question.
preview.bn: Closure = ব্যাকপ্যাক, this = কে ডাকছে তার নাম, prototype = 'না জানলে বাবাকে জিজ্ঞেস করো'।
